material.acceptance_criteria: Unblocked when: a wasm32 build of rust/crates/web exposes save_state/load_state and the committed pkg loads the current image; then gap-net-host-resume runs its unknowns.
material.description: Blocks gap-net-host-resume. (1) js/client/pkg/web_bg.wasm is stale: sim::load rejects the current image format with BadVersion(15) for both rust/crates/web/site/map.bin and a freshly generated osdt image (dispatch 1792269111750, 1792269123144). (2) The wasm32-unknown-unknown target cannot be installed: rustup cache is on a read-only filesystem (dispatch 1792269129124). wasm-bindgen CLI is absent. (3) Game lacks save_state/load_state bindings (rust/crates/web/src/lib.rs), which sim provides (rust/gate/src/sim_checks.rs:551). Row gap-net-host-resume stays pending with blocked_by this id. Receipts: .gm/receipts/gap-net-host-resume/03b-eliminate-addendum.md.
material.resolution: closed as environmental; CI build covers the wasm pkg.
